decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed version of the proven BASIC 518 and already has an established customer base, so its value is largely confirmed and keeping it costs little.
The flail shredder line fits the core mobile business, and there has been no website evidence since 2019 either way, so this low-cost option stays open while its value is still unresolved.

The grinder line was only ever mentioned and its green-waste sibling was already withdrawn, which raises the risk of a drop, but it still fits the core mobile grinding offer and costs little to keep for now.

The stationary pre-shredder line supports the strategic push toward plant solutions and had a prominent presentation, so it is kept as an option for further commitment despite the withdrawal of the fine shredder.
